title: Measuring Faithfulness in Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. The term 'faithfulness' in the title is a technical term from explainable AI, referring to whether a model's stated chain-of-thought reasoning accurately reflects its internal process for arriving at an answer.
models_tested: 175B-parameter pretrained, decoder-only transformer, fine-tuned with RLHF
A series of pretrained, decoder-only transformer models finetuned with RLHF, with varying sizes (e.g., 810M, 1.6B, 13B, up to 175B) from Ganguli et al. (2023)
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it is not a subject of the study.
